blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: An outstanding creative advertising image should both attract attention and communicate a product's positioning. How to choose a persuasive conceptual bridge before rendering begins is challenging for advertising generation. We present AdMuse, a skill-guided multi-agent framework that distills high-quality advertisements into reusable creative skills for cross-domain advertising strategy. Rather than retrieving isolated exemplars, AdMuse abstracts recurring bridge patterns into a skill library that can guide new product briefs. At generation time, AdMuse coordinates skill routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided visual refinement: diverse skills propose alternative concepts, relative judgment selects the most promising direction, and vision-language feedback helps realize the selected intent in the final image. This design treats advertising creativity as a structured decision process rather than a single prompt-writing step. Experiments across diverse product and brand positionings show that AdMuse produces visually compelling advertisements that faithfully communicate product positioning.
blocks.zh: 一个杰出的有创意的广告形象既能吸引人们的注意,又能传达产品的定位. 如何在渲染开始前选择有说服力的概念桥,对于广告生成来说是一个挑战. 我们介绍AdMuse,这是一个技术指导的多代理框架,将高质量的广告提炼成跨领域广告战略的可重复使用的创造技能。 AdMuse摘要不但没有检索孤立的例子,反而将反复出现的桥接模式输入一个能指导新产品简报的技能库. 在一代人的时间,AdMuse协调技能的路由,多扫描的创意和选择,以及由VLM指导的视觉改进:多种技能提出替代概念,相对判断选择最有希望的方向,视觉语言反馈帮助实现最终图像中选定的意图. 这种设计将广告创意视为结构化的决策过程,而不是单一的即时写作步骤. 跨越不同产品和品牌定位的实验显示,AdMuse制作的具有视觉说服力的广告忠实地传达出产品定位.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
Creativity plays a vital role in advertising. Creative advertisements
are more memorable than regular ones ( Till and Baack, 2005 ; Jin et al., 2019 ) . Although modern image generators ( OpenAI, 2026 ) and agentic visual pipelines ( Chen et al., 2026 ) can render high-quality images, they still largely rely on the user to provide the core creative idea. For advertising, however, the main difficulty often lies not in rendering an image, but in deciding what visual concept to use .
A key challenge is that a product can support many creative directions, each producing distinct visual and communicative effects. Advertising generation therefore needs a creative-strategy representation that reveals, compares, and instantiates viable directions ( Koushik et al., 2025 ) . It should generalize across products while guiding visual synthesis, often through cross-domain associations that make desired qualities perceptible.
blocks.zh:
创意在广告中发挥着至关重要的作用。 创意广告
(Til and Baack,2005;Jin等,2019). 虽然现代图像生成器(OpenAI, 2026)和代理视觉管道(Chen等, 2026)能够制作出高质量的图像,但它们仍然在很大程度上依赖于用户提供核心的创意创意. 但是,对于广告来说,主要困难往往不在于渲染出一个图像,而在于决定使用什么视觉概念.
一个关键挑战是,一种产品可以支持许多创造性的方向,每一种产品都会产生独特的视觉和交流效果。 因此,广告一代需要一种创造性的战略代表,揭示、比较和即时说明可行的方向(Koushik等,2025年)。 它应当在指导视觉合成的同时,通过能够使所期望的品质明显可见的跨域协会,对各种产品进行概括。

blocks.en:
We frame this problem through the notion of a creative bridge : a cross-domain association that links a product to a distant concept through an interpretable visual chain. High-quality creative ads repeatedly reuse a limited set of such bridge patterns ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . We therefore distill them into reusable creative skills that specify when a strategy applies, what associative chain it constructs, and how it can be instantiated for a new product brief.
Based on this representation, we propose AdMuse , a skill-guided multi-agent framework for creative advertising image generation. AdMuse routes bridge-diverse skills for a brief, lets multiple skill-conditioned concepts compete through relative judgment, and then refines the selected concept with VLM feedback.
Our contributions are summarized as: • We formalize the creative bridge and distill recurring bridge patterns from advertisements into a reusable skill library. • We propose a skill-guided multi-agent pipeline that combines routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided visual refinement. • We show that AdMuse produces visually compelling and message-faithful advertisements across diverse briefs, products, and positionings (see Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们通过创意桥梁的概念来构建这个问题:通过可解释的视觉链将产品与遥远的概念联系起来的跨域协会。 高质量的创意广告反复重复使用有限的一套此类桥梁模式(Sun等,2025年)。 因此,我们把它们提炼成可重复使用的创新技能,这些技能具体说明战略何时适用,它构建什么关联链条,以及如何为新产品简介进行即时分析。
基于这一表述,我们提议AdMuse, 一个由技能指导的多代理框架,用于创造性的广告形象生成。 AdMuse 路由桥-分流技能为一简短,让多个技能条件化的概念通过相对判断来竞争,再用VLM反馈来完善所选择的概念.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Recent agentic image-generation systems improve synthesis through multi-agent coordination ( Shen et al., 2026 ) and VLM-guided critique ( Yao et al., 2026 ) . In parallel, skill- and memory-based agents show how reusable procedures can guide complex tasks ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . Our work connects these directions by treating advertising ideation itself as a reusable, skill-based strategy before rendering.
Creative advertising also relates to visual metaphor and conceptual blending ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Koushik et al., 2025 ) , where a product is linked to a remote concept through a meaningful visual association. Prior methods typically generate one metaphor per query or rely on direct reference transfer ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . By contrast, we distill recurring bridge patterns from high-quality ads into reusable skills that can be routed and compared for a new brief.
In e-commerce and marketing AIGC, existing systems focus on product staging ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , poster composition ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , or marketing copy generation ( Quan et al., 2025 ) . These approaches usually assume the core idea is already given. We instead address the upstream problem of selecting a persuasive visual concept that communicates product positioning.
blocks.zh:
近期的物剂成像-生成系统通过多剂协调改进合成(沈等,2026年)和VLM-指导批判(姚等,2026年). 同时,基于技能和记忆的代理显示可重复使用的程序如何指导复杂的任务(Zhong等,2026年). 我们的工作将这些方向联系起来,将广告思想本身视为一种可重复使用、基于技能的战略,然后才进行传播。
创意广告也涉及视觉比喻和概念融合(Sun等,2025;Koushik等,2025),其中一产品通过有意义的视觉关联与远程概念相接. 先前的方法通常每个查询产生一个比喻,或依赖直接参考转移(徐等,2026. 相比之下,我们从高质量的广告中提炼出反复出现的桥接模式,使之成为可再用的技能,这些技能可以被路由和比较到一个新的简介.
在电子商务和营销方面,AIGC现有系统侧重于产品中转(Wang等,2025年),海报组成(Gao等,2025年),或营销副本生成(Quan等,2025年)。 这些方法通常假定核心思想已经给出. 相反,我们处理上游问题,即选择一个能传播产品定位的有说服力的视觉概念。

blocks.en: 3.1. Creative Bridges and Skill Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.1. 创造性桥梁和技能扭曲

blocks.en:
The overall framework of AdMuse is shown in Fig. 2 .
We build the skill library from 1,129 1{,}129 creative advertising images spanning 13 product categories. We use Gemini-3.1-Pro to analyze each advertisement and extract a structured record of its product identity, associative space, creative bridge, visual structure, and creative reasoning. Details of the corpus and distillation procedure are provided in Supplementary Sec. 1.

Creative advertising often expresses an abstract product attribute by connecting the product to a remote visual domain, a process closely related to conceptual blending theory ( Fauconnier and Turner, 2008 ) .
We operationalize this mechanism as a creative bridge : a cross-domain mapping from the product source to the target attribute specified by the positioning.
A bridge records the intermediate concepts that carry the mapping, together with the order in which they are visually interpreted.
Formally, (1) b ​ r ​ i ​ d ​ g ​ e : product ​ source → b ​ r ​ i ​ d ​ g ​ e ​ t ​ y ​ p ​ e n 1 → n 2 → ⋯ → n K target , bridge:\quad\mathrm{product\ source}\;\xrightarrow[\;bridge\ type\;]{\;n_{1}\,\to\,n_{2}\,\to\,\cdots\,\to\,n_{K}\;}\;\mathrm{target}, where target \mathrm{target} denotes the attribute to be communicated, n 1 , … , n K n_{1},\ldots,n_{K} ( K ≥ 1 K\geq 1 ) denotes an ordered chain of source-domain concepts, and the bridge type specifies the relation that makes the mapping plausible.

blocks.en: We derive the bridge taxonomy from the annotated corpus rather than prescribing categories manually: recurring mapping relations are consolidated into eight bridge types, after which every advertisement is re-labeled with the taxonomy fixed and assigned to exactly one type: ℬ = { \mathcal{B}=\{ form_analogy , function_transfer , material_texture , origin_environment , cultural_symbol , scale_contrast , process_causation , sensory_amplification } \} .
blocks.zh: 我们从附加说明的目录中得出了桥梁分类法,而不是手动规定分类法: 经常性的绘图关系被整合为8个桥型, 之后每条广告都会被重新标注固定的分类法, 并被分配到完全一种类型: B = { mathcal{B}=\{} 形式_ 分析 , 函数_ 传输 , 材料_文本 , 来源_环境 , 文化_同义词 , 缩放_ Contrast , 进程_原因 , 感知_ amplification } 。

blocks.en:
Bridge types provide a coarse organization of creative relations, but they are not sufficiently specific to guide generation directly.
We therefore cluster normalized embeddings of each record’s associative chain, rationale, and creative reasoning within each bridge family using K-Means, and summarize each cluster as a reusable skill .
A skill packages a reusable creative procedure: a strategy description, bridge type, applicability triggers and anti-triggers, a parameterized associative-chain template, and a playbook specifying construction steps, visual structure, constraints, anti-patterns, and canonical examples.
The complete schema and the S018 skill are provided in Supplementary Sec. 1.3.
blocks.zh:
桥梁类型为创作关系提供了粗糙的组织,但它们不够具体,无法直接引导生成.
因此,我们用K-Means将每个记录的关联链条、原理和创造性推理的嵌入规范化地组合在一起,并将每个组合总结为可重复使用的技能。
一个技能包 一个可重复使用的创造性程序:策略描述,桥型,可适用性触发和反触发,参数化的关联链模板,以及指定构建步骤,视觉结构,约束,反标板等的游戏本和犬类实例.
完整的计划以及S018技能载于补充第1.3节。

blocks.en: 4. Experiments
blocks.zh: 4. 实验

blocks.en: 4.1. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1. 实验设置

blocks.en: Our pipeline uses GPT-5.5 for the IdeaAgent and PromptAgent , Gemini-3.1-Pro for in-loop judging and critique, and GPT-Image-2 for image synthesis. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Qwen3.7-Plus independently evaluate the same final outputs using a shared prompt and rubrics, reducing dependence on a single VLM evaluator ( Li et al., 2025 ) . Further implementation details and hyperparameters are provided in Supplementary Sec. 2.3–2.4.
blocks.zh: 我们的管道使用GPT-5.5 用于Idea Agent和FlaurAgent,双子座-3.1-Pro用于在外判断和批评,而GPT-Image-2用于图像合成. Claude Sonnet 4.6和Qune3.7-Plus使用共享的快取和分号独立评价相同的最终产出,减少对单一VLM评价器的依赖(Li等,2025年). 进一步的实施细节和超参数载于补充第2.3至2.4节。

blocks.en: We evaluate on 500 briefs covering 420 product images across 13 categories, held out from the 1,129-ad distillation corpus to prevent leakage. We compare AdMuse with four baselines: Direct sends the brief directly to the image renderer (GPT-Image-2); LLM-Rewrite expands the brief into a detailed image-generation prompt; RAG-Retrieve retrieves one visual sketch from the reference corpus as inspiration; and RAG-Refine , feeds the top- 3 3 retrieved ad records into the same idea–judge–prompt–critic loop as our system, but without skill routing or templates. Detailed implementations are provided in Supplementary Sec. 3.2.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了500份简介,涵盖13个类别的420个产品图像,这些简介来自防止泄漏的1 129个蒸馏装置。 我们把AdMuse与四个基线相比较: 直接将简介直接发送到图像渲染器(GPT-Image-2); LLM-Rewrite将简介扩展为详细的图像生成快取; RAG-Retrive从参考文献中取出一幅视觉素描作为灵感; RAG-Refine,将3所检索到的广告记录输入到与我们系统相同的理念中 – judge-prompt-critic 循环,但没有技能路由或模板. 详细执行情况载于补充第3.2节。

blocks.en: 4.2. Quantitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2. 定量评价

blocks.en: We report two evaluation metrics: Creativity Score (CS) , which measures the novelty and conceptual impact of the advertisement, and Alignment Score (AS) , which measures how clearly the image communicates the intended positioning while preserving product identity. Both scores are assigned by two independent out-of-loop VLM judges under the same protocol. Full rubrics and prompt details are deferred to Supplementary Sec. 3.3. As shown in Table 1 , AdMuse achieves the highest average, CS, and AS scores on the 500-brief benchmark, outperforming all four baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们报告两个评价衡量标准:创造性评分(CS)衡量广告的新颖性和概念影响;对等评分(AS)衡量图像在保持产品身份的同时如何清晰地传达预定的定位。 两个分数都由两名独立出局的VLM裁判根据同一协议分配. 完整的标题和即时细节推迟到补充第3.3节。 如表1所示,AdMuse在500brief基准上取得了最高的平均水平CS和AS分数,比所有四个基线都高。

blocks.en: 4.3. Qualitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3. 定性评价

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , the baselines tend to either render the brief literally or add visual polish without forming a cross-domain mapping. In contrast, AdMuse more consistently translates the positioning into a concrete cross-domain visual concept while maintaining product visibility: the Del Monte can appears as fruit freshly “picked by nature” among peach branches, returning packaged product to its origin environment; the Roomba becomes a vinyl record, recasting effortless cleaning as pressing play on free time; a Lay’s chip turns into a smiling button on a denim jacket by form analogy; and a gummy bear serves as a zipper pull that zips generations together. In each case, the product assumes a role in the target domain rather than merely appearing in a themed scene.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,基线往往要么从字面上渲染简短,要么在不形成跨域映射的情况下添加视觉光泽. 相比之下,AdMuse在保持产品能见度的同时,更一致地将定位转化为具体的跨域视觉概念:Del Monte可以在桃花枝中作为新鲜的水果"被自然取出"而出现,将被包装出的产品还原到原生环境;Roomba成为了一种花花公子唱片,将无劳的清洁作为自由时间的紧迫游戏;Lay的芯片通过形式类比在denim夹克上变成微笑的扣子;而一头笨熊则起到拉链式拉链的作用,把几代人拉在一起。 在每一种情况下,产品都要在目标领域发挥作用,而不是仅仅出现在主题场景中。

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 结论

blocks.en:
This paper introduced AdMuse , a skill-guided multi-agent framework for creative advertising image generation. We distill recurring cross-domain creative bridges from high-quality ads into reusable creative skills . AdMuse uses these skills for strategy routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided refinement.
Future work can explore more explicit controls over creativity, alignment, and brand preference in advertising workflows.
blocks.zh:
本文引入了AdMuse,这是一个由技能指导的多代理架构,用于创意广告图像生成. 我们把反复出现的跨域创意桥梁从高质量的广告中提炼成可重复使用的创意技能。 AdMuse将这些技能用于策略的路由,多扫描的构思和选择,以及VLM指导的完善.
未来的工作可以探索在广告工作流程中更明确地控制创意,调和,以及品牌偏好.
